description: NaSb₅O₁₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ama2 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.65 Å. There are three inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-53°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.08 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-53°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.05 Å. In the third Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-46°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.13 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three Sb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Sb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Sb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Sb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sb atoms.
